messages:
From: Laila Hassan <laila@medinsight.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Packaging question: pilot burst and tier swap

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about what Redwood can do for our triage pipelines. A couple of questions came up from engineering and procurement as we scope the pilot:

- We want to run a 6-week pilot using Hosted API initially, but expect a 48-72 hour burst period mid-pilot where throughput needs to spike ~6x. Is it possible to temporarily upgrade to a higher tier / burst capacity for that window and then revert without a long-term commitment?
- We have ~12 seats across two squads for the pilot. Can seats be bundled into a shared pool (so both squads draw from a single concurrency pool)? If we do move to Dedicated later, will those seats convert or be credited?
- Procurement is asking what discounts/credits are available if we commit to a 6-month reserved Dedicated pool after a successful pilot.

Procurement asked me to include them on follow ups: procurement@medinsight.com. Can you outline options and any rough pricing impact? If you can attach a quick packing/options sheet and an estimate of monthly token costs for our expected volume, that would be great.

Thanks,

Dr. Laila Hassan
Head of AI Platforms
MedInsight

Attachments: MedInsight_RFP_summary.docx (see referenced usage numbers)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laila Hassan <laila@medinsight.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question: pilot burst and tier swap

Hi Laila — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front, then a recommended path.

TL;DR: Yes — we support short-term burst upgrades and seat pooling for Hosted-to-Dedicated transitions. We typically recommend:
- Start pilot on Hosted API (lowest friction) with a pre-approved burst allocation for the mid-pilot spike. We can guarantee burst capacity if you reserve a short burst window; otherwise we provide best-effort with automatic fallback to a compatible smaller model variant.
- Configure a shared seat pool during the pilot (12 seats -> shared concurrency pool). If you move to Dedicated, we’ll convert pilot seat usage into credits toward reserved capacity (prorated).
- Discount structure: we can offer a 10% onboarding discount for the pilot invoice and a tiered discount (12–15%) on reserved Dedicated committed spend for 6 months, depending on committed GPU-pool size.

I'll attach two helpful artifacts: MedInsight_MA_PackOptions.pdf (pack/feature options and tradeoffs) and MedInsight_Usage_Estimates.xlsx (rough token/cost estimates based on your RFP numbers). See the attachments.

A couple of clarifying questions so Sean can draft a compact quote:
1) Do you know the target sustained qps outside of the burst window? (helpful to size reserved capacity)
2) For the burst window, do you need guaranteed latency SLOs or is throughput the priority?

Next steps: Sean — can you prepare a conservative quote (Hosted pilot + burst uplift option + 6-month Dedicated commit scenarios) and include a proposed discount ladder? Laila — if procurement wants specific legal/ SOC2 language we should loop legal early.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: MedInsight_MA_PackOptions.pdf; MedInsight_Usage_Estimates.xlsx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laila Hassan <laila@medinsight.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question: pilot burst and tier swap — draft pricing

Laila / Monica — putting numbers on paper based on the usage estimate you sent (thanks Laila). This is a conservative, configurable quote — we can tighten with real telemetry after week 1 of the pilot.

Option A — Hosted pilot + optional burst uplift (no long-term commit)
- Baseline Hosted API: metered per-token + concurrency. Estimated pilot cost (6 weeks): ~$11k–$14k depending on model mix.
- Burst uplift add-on: reserve a 72-hour burst slab that guarantees capacity for a single window during the pilot. Cost to reserve: one-off $2,500 (covers guaranteed capacity) or we can do on-demand at a usage premium (approx +40% during the spike).

Option B — Pilot -> 6-month Dedicated conversion (recommended if you expect ongoing high throughput)
- If you commit to a 6-month Dedicated pool sized for your sustained qps + expected burst multiplier, we can offer 12% discount on committed spend.
- If you commit to a higher minimum (larger GPU pool), we can move to 15% for the first 6 months and a dedicated onboarding credit equal to 15% of the pilot invoice applied toward month 1 of Dedicated.

Seat pooling / credits: seats used as part of Hosted pilot will be credited toward Dedicated reserved capacity, prorated based on actual usage during the pilot. Unused reserved seats are eligible for partial credit on conversion (we detail in the SOW).

Legal / procurement asks: we can include SOC2 and data retention language in the SOW. For pausing/pausable capacity: we support pause-with-30-day-notice for Dedicated pools with prorated billing after pause (see note below).

I've attached a draft quote (Quote_DEAL-4821_v1.pdf) with line items. Aditya — can you confirm the maximum discount authority for AE-led deals so I can include an approval path?

If this aligns, propose a 30-minute call Thurs 1/22 at 10am PT to finalize numbers and capture procurement’s must-haves.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks Sean — that helps a lot. A few follow-ups from procurement and engineering:

- Procurement: are reserved Dedicated seats refundable or pausable? We need the option to pause if headcount or budget shifts; proration rules requested. Also please include a simple list of contract exceptions (SOC2, data deletion timeline, audit logs access).
- Engineering: the 72-hour burst guarantee is what we need, but latency is important during the spike; will we see model fallbacks that increase latency if the burst slab is exhausted?

Procurement has asked that any conversion credits be explicitly line-itemized on the SOW and on the quote. They prefer credits applied as invoice credits rather than future term inflation adjustments.

We can do the Thurs 1/22 call — procurement is available if you can do 10am PT. Please have the SOW/quote table updated with pause/proration terms and the explicit crediting flow.

Best,
Laila

Subject: Re: Packaging question: pilot burst and tier swap — next steps and approvals

Hi all — following up after the call earlier today. Quick summary and confirmed positions so procurement has everything in one place.

Confirmed commercial path:
- Pilot: Hosted API, shared 12-seat concurrency pool, conservative monitoring for week 1 to refine sizing.
- Burst: 72-hour guaranteed burst slab (reserved) for the window in mid-pilot. One-off reserve fee ($2,500) if MedInsight requires guaranteed capacity; otherwise on-demand with usage premium.
- Conversion: If MedInsight converts to Dedicated within 30 days of pilot end, pilot invoices are eligible for a 15% onboarding credit applied as an invoice credit to month 1 of Dedicated when committing to a min 6-month Dedicated spend at the higher GPU pool level. If MedInsight commits to a lower minimum pool, conversion credit is 12%.
- Pause/proration: Dedicated pools can be paused with 30 days notice. Billing is prorated to the day; unused reserved capacity after pause is eligible for a one-time credit equal to the prorated value of the remaining full months (to be line-itemed in the SOW).
- Legal: SOC2 and data deletion language will be added to SOW; audit log access via secure share will be included.

Action items:
1) Sean to update Quote_DEAL-4821_v1.pdf with explicit credit line items and a pause/proration clause by EOD Fri 1/23.
2) Monica to share SOW template with procurement and legal redlines by Mon 1/26.
3) Laila / procurement to confirm pilot start date (target 2/2/2026) and provide sustained qps estimate.

Approval path: I (Aditya) can approve up to 15% discount for AE-led conversions. Anything beyond that will require sales leadership signoff.

If that all looks good, Monica — we can send a refreshed DocuSign quote and SOW for signature once procurement signs off on the credit flow. Proposed next call: Mon 1/26 9am PT to finalize SOW redlines.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
